notes: Standalone example: firewall state and disk encryption as text. The built-in sensor reports the firewall profiles, BitLocker volumes (and escrows recovery passwords), Defender status and AppLocker enforcement as structured fields; this example prints the headline state only.

commands.linux:
# Standalone example: firewall and disk encryption state as text.
# The built-in sensor detects ufw, firewalld, nftables and iptables and walks the block-device tree for LUKS.
if command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then ufw status | head -1; elif command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "firewalld: $(firewall-cmd --state 2>/dev/null)"; else echo 'firewall: none detected'; fi
lsblk -rno TYPE,MOUNTPOINT | awk '$1=="crypt"{print "encrypted: " ($2==""?"(unmounted)":$2)}'
commands.darwin:
# Standalone example: application firewall and FileVault state as text.
/usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw --getglobalstate
fdesetup status
